classification.difficultyReason: Reflect each point across the named axis, retaining its horizontal coordinate and reversing its vertical coordinate, including recognising that a point on the mirror stays fixed.

content.prompt: Copy these points onto a number plane and find their images under reflection in the $x$-axis.

answer.worked: Plot $A(2,-1)$. Its image is 1 unit above the $x$-axis on the same vertical grid line: $A'(2,1)$.
Plot $B(-3,3)$. Its image is 3 units below the $x$-axis on the same vertical grid line: $B'(-3,-3)$.
$C$ lies on the axis of reflection, so it stays fixed: $C'(-5,0)$.
Plot $D(0,4)$. Its image is 4 units below the $x$-axis on the $y$-axis: $D'(0,-4)$.

spec.description: Complete coordinate plot of the four original points and their reflections. The fixed point C has a combined label.
spec.mathematics: Reflection in the x-axis preserves x and changes the sign of y.
